evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' issues a direct command to discard knowledge — a coercive pressure move demanding compliance through insistence.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Imperative 'Remove' repeats the same coercive demand — insistence on knowledge destruction as a pressure tactic.
